description: 국가철도공단_열차별운행시각표 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 또한 철도 운영기관은 이를 활용해 운행 스케줄을 효율적으로 관리하고 조정하며, 운행 혼잡도 예측, 자원 배분, 서비스 품질 향상 등에 중요한 기초 자료로 활용합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 열차운행, 열차시간, 시간표, 운행요일정보, 운행번호별정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
